combat._doc: Shared combat constants. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-combat.md. Key suffixes give units: S = seconds, M = metres, Mps = metres per second, Deg = degrees, Ticks = ticks. Unsuffixed fractions are decimals (0.04 = 4%) and convert to basis points; points (HP, focus, armor, ward, composure) are integers. Loaders convert once: metres x100 -> cm for events and displays (sim positions and per-tick movement are integer mm, x1000, per D-E), seconds x20 -> ticks, fractions x10000 -> bp; every value converts exactly.
combat.status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (combat designer). Values are PROPOSED · TUNABLE unless the spec says REQUIRED.

attributes.name: Strength
attributes.description: Raw force. Drives Power for heavy and melee classes and adds a little max HP.

attributes.name: Agility
attributes.description: Hand speed and footwork. Faster basic attacks and a chance to evade weapon blows.

attributes.name: Pace
attributes.description: Running speed. How fast a fighter closes, chases, kites and escapes.

attributes.name: Toughness
attributes.description: Durability. The main source of max HP and a little armor. Races modify it (durability tag).

attributes.name: Precision
attributes.description: Aim and timing. Critical-hit chance, and Power for archers and throwers.

attributes.name: Arcana
attributes.description: Command of spellcraft. Power for casters, arcane blades and hexers.

attributes.name: Spirit
attributes.description: Inner warmth that mends others. The main source of Support (healing and shields).

attributes.name: Willpower
attributes.description: Resistance to magic. Ward against arcane damage and shorter slows and debuffs.

attributes.name: Composure
attributes.description: Calm under pressure. Shorter stuns and roots, steadier reactions when hurt or when the captain falls.

attributes.name: Leadership
attributes.description: Command presence. The main input to captaincy; no effect on a fighter who is not captain.

attributes.name: Awareness
attributes.description: Reading the fight. Shorter reaction delay when the fighter changes what it is doing.

attributes.name: Discipline
attributes.description: Pacing and self-control. Faster focus regeneration, so more abilities per round.

archetypes.name: Tank
archetypes.description: Front-liners who soak damage, protect allies and hold enemies in place.

archetypes.name: Melee DPS
archetypes.description: Close-quarters damage dealers who dive, duel and finish.

archetypes.name: Ranged DPS
archetypes.description: Damage from a distance; fragile if caught.

archetypes.name: Controller
archetypes.description: Slows, roots, stuns, silences and debuffs that shape where and how the fight happens.

archetypes.name: Healer
archetypes.description: Restore HP, shield allies and cleanse harmful effects.

derived._doc: d(x) = effective attribute - 10. Coefficients are per attribute point. Each formula truncates toward zero once, at its end.

combatModsDefaults._doc: Optional per-fighter hooks (race or future content). Neutral defaults. Races act mainly through attribute tendencies on lifecycle tags (Toughness carries the durability tag).

roundEnd._doc: Applied at the hard cap, and when both sides lose their last fighter on the same tick. First difference wins.

captain._doc: sys-fight-captain. Adopts the lifecycle proposal (development.json captaincy.inFightProposal): reliability through composure, never raw damage. Grades come from development.json captaincy.grades by CQ; CQ arrives with the fight setup.

aura.scope: every fielded ally including the acting captain, while the acting captain is standing

rally.trigger: first ally other than the acting captain downed while the acting captain stands

down.handover: when Shaken ends: vice-captain if fielded and standing, else the standing ally with the highest CQ (ties: lower slot); acting CQ = CQ - development.json captaincy.actingCaptainCqPenalty

traitEffectAdapter._doc: How traits.json effects owned by combat enter the fight (sys-fight-traits). Each "combat" effect becomes one statMod per mod key with the mapped predicate. Trait-sourced mods are summed per stat and capped by derived.traitModCaps.

otherTypes.enemyComposureAura: aura on enemies within the named band: statMod composure = add
otherTypes.shakenImmune: multiplies negative composure from Shaken and from allyDown-conditioned mods by mult (0 = immune)
otherTypes.captainRally: if this fighter is acting captain, multiplies rally composure (truncated) and rally duration by mult

randomness._doc: All draws use core/rng (sfc32 + cyrb128). Round seed = deriveSeed(matchSeed, "round", n). Purpose streams are derived from the round seed by label so adding a roll type never shifts another.

streams.use: initial crit and evade accumulator phases: 2 draws at fight start
one draw per damage instance the unit deals
opening stagger (1 draw) and reaction jitter (1 draw per committed decision change)
final coin flip of the round-end tiebreak only

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.description: Cannot move, attack or use abilities. Interrupts casts and channels.

statuses.name: Asleep
statuses.description: As Stunned, but wakes at the end of any tick in which it took damage of at least 8% of its max HP.

statuses.name: Rooted
statuses.description: Cannot move or dash. Can still attack and cast. Ends mobile channels.

statuses.name: Silenced
statuses.description: Cannot use active abilities. Basic attacks still work. Interrupts casts and channels.

statuses.name: Taunted
statuses.description: Rules are suspended: must move to and basic-attack the taunter. The latest taunt wins.

statuses.name: Slowed
statuses.description: Move speed reduced. Only the strongest slow applies.

statuses.name: Sluggish
statuses.description: Attack speed reduced. Only the strongest applies.

statuses.name: Hasted
statuses.description: Move speed increased.

statuses.name: Frenzied
statuses.description: Attack speed increased.

statuses.description: Attack speed increased per stack. Separate from Frenzied, so both apply.

statuses.name: Empowered
statuses.description: Deals more damage.

statuses.name: Weakened
statuses.description: Deals less damage.

statuses.name: Shaken
statuses.description: The acting captain fell: composure reduced for a few seconds (sys-fight-captain). Some traits reduce or ignore it.

statuses.name: Fortified
statuses.description: Takes less damage.

statuses.name: Vulnerable
statuses.description: Takes more damage.

statuses.name: Marked
statuses.description: A posted bounty: takes more damage from everyone. Separate from Vulnerable, so both apply.

statuses.name: Armored
statuses.description: Armor increased (flat).

statuses.name: Sundered
statuses.description: Armor reduced (flat, never below 0).

statuses.name: Warded
statuses.description: Ward increased (flat).

statuses.name: Unwarded
statuses.description: Ward reduced (flat, never below 0).

statuses.name: Festering
statuses.description: Receives less healing and smaller shields.

statuses.name: Barbed
statuses.description: Reflects part of the weapon damage taken from attackers in melee range.

statuses.name: Bloodthirsty
statuses.description: Heals for part of the damage it deals.

statuses.name: Evasive
statuses.description: Higher chance to evade weapon blows (total evade is capped at 75%).

statuses.name: Bleeding
statuses.description: Takes physical damage every tick interval.

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.description: Takes arcane damage every tick interval.

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.description: Takes arcane damage every tick interval; stacks.

statuses.name: Regenerating
statuses.description: Heals every tick interval.

statuses.name: Guarded

statuses.name: Anchored

statuses.name: Illuminated

statuses.description: The captain's rally after an ally fell: composure increased, ally-down penalties suppressed.

races._doc: Playable races (sys-races). Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md. All age curves derive from lifespan via humanAge = age * 80 / lifespan (O11). statTendencies are offsets in stat points (1-20 scale) applied to per-stat caps at generation. The 'derived' blocks are EXAMPLE reference values from the spec's worked examples and soak model; code must compute from the formulas and never read them. Fractions are decimals here; the loader converts them to integer basis points.
races.status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). Lifespan scaling, human peak 28, elf ~42, and 'long-lived = more injury-prone, orcs/dwarves shorter-lived and more durable' are REQUIRED (O11); the values chosen for them and everything else are PROPOSED / TUNABLE.

stats._doc: statTendencies are keyed by the combat.json attribute ids (final): physical str (Strength), agi (Agility), pac (Pace), tgh (Toughness, the durability input to sys-injury), pre (Precision); mental arc (Arcana), spi (Spirit), wil (Willpower), cmp (Composure), ldr (Leadership), awr (Awareness), dis (Discipline). The physical/mental group comes from combat.json. Tendencies are cap offsets in stat points at generation.
stats._capNote: TUNABLE (combat cmb-q11): |statTendency| <= 4 per stat; races express fragility and durability mainly through injury multipliers, not raw stat gaps. Current values stay within +/-1.6.

classArchetypes._doc: Soft class affinities are keyed by combat.json affinityGroups (each class in classes.json has one affinityGroup). Generation weight of a class = 1 * race.classAffinity[class.affinityGroup]. Affinity never changes in-fight power.

traits._doc: Fighter traits (sys-traits). Crusader-Kings-style personality, physique and history traits; every name and text is original. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md. Stat ids are the combat.json attribute ids (str agi pac tgh pre arc spi wil cmp ldr awr dis). Each effect's 'owner' (see effectTypes) says who applies it: 'management' effects are applied by lifecycle/economy code before or outside the fight (stat adds arrive in the fight setup's effective stats and must not be re-applied); 'sim' effects are applied inside the fight by combat (sys-fight-traits, combat.json traitEffectAdapter; docs/design/03 boundary contract 3). Whole-point stat adds are capped at +/-3 per stat per trait (statAddCapPerTrait, TUNABLE). effectText must be updated by whoever changes a number. Fractions are decimals; the loader converts them to basis points.
traits.status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). ~80/20 positive/negative is REQUIRED (O5); catalogue, weights, numbers and the roll algorithm are PROPOSED / TUNABLE.

rollRules._doc: Roll per generated fighter, generation stream STREAM.traits: (1) n from countWeights; (2) the fighter gets exactly one negative trait with probability negativeChancePerTrait * n (40% / 60% / 80% for 2 / 3 / 4 traits), otherwise none: ~20% of rolled traits are negative and no starting fighter has more than one; (3) roll the negative first (if any), then the positives, each a weighted pick among eligible traits of that polarity using rollWeight * raceWeight[race] (missing raceWeight = 1). If no eligible trait remains for a slot it stays empty (no polarity swap, so the one-negative cap always holds).
eligibility: neither trait lists the other in opposites or excludes (checked both ways)
not in the same exclusiveGroup as a held trait
rookieOnly traits only if humanAge <= rookieOnlyMaxHumanAge at generation

kinds.edge: net positive with a small drawback
kinds.burden: net negative with a real upside or niche
kinds.flaw: pure negative; every rolled flaw has a visible way to lose it (scars are flaws by design and permanent, O-ladder)

rarityBands._doc: Labels follow the expected share of generated fighters holding the trait (Monte Carlo over all races).
rarityBands.storied: never rolled; earned through events, captaincy or injury

revealOrder._doc: FUTURE (M4 scouting, P-12, research D3) hook; M1 shows every trait. Tier = the knowledge step that reveals the trait.

effectTypes.description: Whole-point modifier to the effective attribute (|add| <= statAddCapPerTrait). Base stats are untouched; losing the trait removes it. Included in fight-setup stats.
Stat modifier applied to fight-setup stats only in matches of that competition type.
Multiplies the development-clock advance for the group while humanAge during the season is in range.
Multiplies wear accrued per season.
Looks up the decline table at humanAge - humanYears (positive = decline starts later).
Multiplies XP per round (floor after all multipliers).
Multiplies the strength of training emphasis effects (0 = emphasis has no effect).
Multiplies per-round injury chance (rolled by sys-injury after each round).
Multiplies injury weeks for severities that scale with recovery.
Multiplies scar chance on moderate and serious injuries.
Multiplies the season retirement chance.
Adds to captaincy (CQ 1-100).
Club-mates with humanAge <= 23 get this development multiplier (at most 2 trait mentors per club count; all mentoring capped at x1.15).
Adds to lineup chemistry while this fighter is fielded (sys-chemistry, applied as a fight-setup composure modifier).
Chemistry per other fielded fighter of the same race, capped; ifNone applies when there is none.
Applied once per unordered pair of fielded fighters that both hold withTrait.
Applied once per lineup if at least minHolders fielded fighters hold withTrait.
This fighter does not receive the lineup chemistry composure modifier, good or bad.
FUTURE (M3, P-07): changes the fighter rule-slot count, within 4..12.
Input for the league/economy designer (economy.json wage.traitAdj): fanAppeal (add), wageDemandMult (mult), loyalty (add).

names._doc: Original name parts per race. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md (sys-generation, names). A name = pattern filled from the race's part lists with the generation RNG. Parts are concatenated as written (capitalise the first letter of each assembled word). All parts are original; the blocklist rejects accidental matches with well-known fictional names.
names.status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). Lists TUNABLE; rules REQUIRED.

rules.onExhaustion: append a roman numeral epithet (II, III, ...) to the last attempt

placeholders.{given}, {given2}: given.prefixes + (given.middles if present) + given.suffixes, each picked uniformly
placeholders.{family}, {familyA}, {familyB}: family.prefixes + family.suffixes, picked uniformly; familyA != familyB
placeholders.{place}, {house}, {epithet}, {flame}: one entry of the race list with that key, picked uniformly

development._doc: Fighter lifecycle constants: development, aging, retirement, injuries, captaincy, chemistry, statuses, generation. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-fighter-lifecycle.md. Units follow docs/design/03 section 1: stats are integers on the absolute 1-20 scale, rating and potential are integers 1-100, probabilities are basis points in code. Fractions and multipliers are decimals in this file; the loader converts every fractional value to integer basis points (x10000, round half away from zero) and lifecycle math runs on integers. Base stats are stored internally as hundredths of a point ('centipoints', 100-2000). Tables given as [key, value] pairs are step tables (use the entry with the largest key <= the lookup value) unless the block says interpolate.
development.status: DRAFT 2026-10-25 (fighter-lifecycle designer). Owner-mandated parts cite O-IDs in the spec; everything else is PROPOSED and every number is TUNABLE.

scale._capsNote: TUNABLE (combat cmb-q11): race tendencies |x| <= 4 per stat, trait stat adds |x| <= 3 per stat; fragility/durability is expressed mainly through injury chance and recovery multipliers. Validator-enforced.
scale._doc: Display stat = floor(effective centipoints / 100), clamp 1..20; this integer is what combat receives (fight setup). Effective centipoints = base centipoints + 100 * (sum of whole-point trait, status and chemistry modifiers). Rating = clamp(round(5 * sum(w_i * stat_i)), 1, 100) on these integer stats (D-Q: one formula everywhere), with w_i = classes.json ratingWeights of the fighter's class. Potential = the same formula with every base stat at its cap, no wear, and only permanent modifiers (physique and scar traits); it therefore drops when a scar is gained (P-12 'injury' change).

time._doc: humanAge = age * 80 / race.lifespan, kept in tenths (floor(age * 800 / lifespan) / 10). Season rate scale k = 80 / race.lifespan. Development and decline of a season use the age the fighter had during that season; the +1 increment follows (season-end step 5).

potential._doc: Potential P (1-100) is rolled once at generation and is mostly fixed (P-12). Bands are generation weights only; the star display is potential / 20 in half-star steps (docs/design/03 section 1).
potential.capFromPotential: cap100_i = clamp(round(P * 20 + classOffset100_i + 100 * race.statTendencies[tag_i] + jitter100_i), capMin*100, capMax*100)

classOffsetFromEmphasis._doc: classOffset_i (points) = clamp(perEmphasisPoint * (class.statEmphasis_i - 1), min, max), then recentred so that sum(ratingWeights_i * classOffset_i) = 0. Uses classes.json statEmphasis; if a class has none, fall back to fallbackByRatingWeightRank.

qualityShiftExamples._label: EXAMPLE. The league/economy designer owns tier quality bands (docs/design/03 section 1) and sets these.

pace._doc: Hidden development pace (true value shown in M1; fog hook for M4). Multiplies the development clock.

developmentClock._doc: Two clocks per fighter, D_physical and D_mental, in human-years of development (stored in hundredths). Per season: dD_g = k * pace * usage * race.growthMult[g] * emphasisMult[g] * traitDevMult[g] * mentorMult(if humanAge <= 23), capped at maxDeltaPerSeason. usage = usageFloor + (1 - usageFloor) * min(1, seasonXp / xp.seasonTarget).

maturityCurve._doc: developed100_i = cap100_i * M_g(D_g + bloom_i). Interpolate linearly; clamp below the first and above the last point.

decline._doc: Wear in stat points per human-year (step table on floor(humanAge during the season) - traitDeclineShift). Per season: wear100_i += 100 * d_g * k * race.declineMult[g] * traitDeclineMult * emphasisWearMult. base100_i = max(100, developed100_i - wear100_i). Wear never heals.
decline._mentalDeclineNote: DELEGATED (D-B; open-025 pending owner confirmation): true. true: mental decline starts at humanAge 60 for every race (elf 90, dwarf 54, orc 48, ashkin 39), i.e. never during a playing career. false: it starts at absolute age 60 for every race (elf humanAge 40, the last seasons of an elf career).

xp._doc: XP is earned only for rounds a fighter starts (O3: a called-up fighter who is not used gains no XP). Bench, injured, unused called-up academy fighters and free agents earn 0.
xp._seasonTargetNote: TUNABLE: about 70% of the XP a full-time starter earns over 16 best-of-3 league matches (16 * ~2.5 rounds * ~12.8 XP). Recompute if the match format changes.

training._doc: DELEGATED (D-A, docs/design/03 sys-development): a standing training emphasis per fighter (set once, persists; not a weekly chore). It shapes WHICH stats the earned growth goes to, never how much: with emphasisBonus = offEmphasisPenalty the physical and mental multipliers always sum to 2, and bodyWearReduction is 0 (no wear effect). fBody and fMind are the season's shares of the 23 weeks under each emphasis. Setting enabled=false makes everyone Balanced, which reproduces no-training behaviour exactly. Emphasis is not intensity and has no injury risk.

formulas.a: product of trainingEmphasis effect mults (human Adaptable 1.5, Regimented 1.5, Set in Their Ways 0); clamp a to [0, 2]

trend._doc: Live development trend = projected rating change at season end if the fighter's XP per matchweek so far continues (projected seasonXp = seasonXp * 19 / weeksElapsed).
trend._rounding: projected delta is an integer rating difference; pick the first level whose minDelta <= delta

retirement._doc: D-T: p = 1 - (1 - hDrop)(1 - hAge)^k with hDrop at careerPeakRating - rating, hAge at human-age - physicalPeakHumanAge, k = 80 / lifespan; then the modifiers; 0 below minHumanAge, 1 from forcedHumanAge. Rolled at season-end step 7.
retirement.modifierOrder: multiply (usage, contract, trait mults), then add (scars, heavy wear), then clamp
retirement._finalSeasonNote: At preseason week P1, a fighter whose chance (computed with usage 1.0) is >= 60% announces a final season: status final_season, retirement certain at season end.
retirement._leavingNote: A free agent unsigned at two consecutive season ends leaves the league (removed like a retirement but not counted as one for intake).

injury._doc: Per-round chance p = (base + damagePerMaxHp * min(cap, damageTaken / maxHp) + downedAdd * [downed]) * durabilityMult * race.injury.chanceMult * ageMult * traitMults * statusMults, capped. Rolled after each round from the injury stream; at most one new injury per fighter per match; injuries take effect when the match ends (the fighter plays out the match).
injury.weeksSemantics: weeksOut counts matchweeks (and preseason weeks) the fighter is unavailable, starting with the week after the injury. It decreases by 1 at each week processing; the offseason removes offseasonRecoveryWeeks.

careerEnding._doc: Impossible unless the fighter shows the At risk flag before the match. The lineup screen shows the per-match chance.

injury.pronenessIndex: race.injury.chanceMult * durabilityMult * ageMult * traitMults (1.0 = average human of durability 10 aged under 30)

captaincy._doc: Captain quality CQ (the 'captaincy' integer 1-100 that combat.json captain consumes) = round(sum(weight * component)) + youth penalty + trait and status captaincy adds, clamp 1..100. Components are 0-100: leadership = effective ldr (1-20) * 5; composure = effective cmp * 5; experience = min(100, careerRounds * 100 / experienceCareerRoundsFor100); seniority = min(100, matchweeksAtClub * 100 / seniorityMatchweeksFor100); standing = clamp(pivot + perRatingPointVsTopFiveAvg * (rating - mean rating of the club's five best fit fighters), 0, 100). CQ is recomputed at every lineup lock and at season end.

inFightProposal._doc: ADOPTED by combat (combat.json captain, docs/design/_drafts/03-combat.md sys-fight-captain); applied by the SIM. Grades supply auraComposure and rallyComposure (in-fight composure points). Lifecycle supplies each fighter's CQ, the lineup captain and the vice-captain in the fight setup. Reliability, not damage (research D2/C8).
inFightProposal.aura: while the acting captain stands: every fielded ally (captain included) gets grade.auraComposure composure

rally.trigger: first time per round an ally other than the acting captain is downed while the acting captain stands

captainDown.handover: when Shaken ends: the vice-captain if fielded and standing, else the standing ally with the highest CQ (ties: lower slot); acting CQ = CQ - actingCaptainCqPenalty, grade recomputed

inFightProposal.effectCap: captain-sourced modifiers may not change any combat quantity by more than 10%

captaincy.lineupCaptain: the club captain if fielded; else the vice-captain if fielded; else the highest-CQ fielded fighter (ties: seniority, rating, fighter id). That fighter is the lineup's captain for the match; combat receives their CQ, minus actingCaptainCqPenalty unless they are the club captain. If the lineup captain is downed, combat's handover passes the role to the vice-captain if fielded and up, else the highest-CQ fielded ally who is up, also at CQ - actingCaptainCqPenalty.

viceCaptain.aiPolicy: second-highest CQ among the five projected starters

mentoring.source: club captain's grade.mentorDevMult, pro-rated by the share of the season's matchweeks they held the role at this club

strip.evaluatedAt: lineup lock (so changing the club captain back and forth between matches is free)
strip.appliesWhen: the club captain at this lock differs from the one at the previous lock, and the previous captain is still at the club, fit, held the role >= 4 matchweeks, and no exemption applies
exemptIf: previous captain injured with >= 4 weeks remaining
previous captain is made vice-captain at the same lock

passedOver.evaluatedAt: lineup lock after a captain change
passedOver.appliesTo: each fit club-mate with humanAge >= 30 and CQ >= new club captain CQ + 15 who is not the vice-captain

captainDeparted.appliesWhen: a club captain who held the role >= 19 matchweeks leaves the club, or suffers a career-ending injury, before season end

captaincy.aiPolicy: AI clubs name as club captain the highest CQ among their five projected starters at preseason week P1 and whenever the role falls vacant; ties: seniority, rating, fighter id. D-I (agreed lifecycle/economy timing): the choice is made in the season-end AI phase for the new season, and an incumbent is replaced there only if a challenger exceeds him by economy.json ai.captainHysteresis (5) CQ; mid-season the AI changes captain only on vacancy or when the captain is injured with >= 4 weeks remaining (an exempt change), so it never triggers Snubbed. Vacancy for the player: the game names an interim captain (same rule) and flags it in the digest.

chemistry._doc: DELEGATED (D-D): in M1, chemistry is limited to these lineup modifiers; no broader morale system. Structural and visible (P-17). Lineup chemistry for the five fielded fighters = sum of trait chemistry terms (captain's own terms x captainTraitChemistryMult) + club captain grade.chemistry + status terms, computed at lineup lock and clamped to [min, max]. Every fielded fighter without chemistryImmune gets cmp + chemistry / 2 (rounded toward zero) in the fight-setup stats; this is a MANAGEMENT-side modifier (the sim only sees the resulting stat). Set composureDivisor to 0 to disable chemistry without touching other data.

worldGen._doc: Sample a band, then a whole humanAge in it, then age = round(humanAge * lifespan / 80), clamped to [race.debutAge.min, age at humanAge 40].

intake._doc: TUNABLE; coordinate with the league/economy designer (trials day, P-18). rookies = clamp(round(clubs * basePerClub) + retirementsThisSeason, round(clubs * minPerClub), round(clubs * maxPerClub)). retirementsThisSeason counts retirements and career-ending injuries, not unsigned fighters who left the league (that would feed back into itself). Race by race.intakeWeight; age uniform in race.debutAge.

veteranHistory._doc: Fighters generated older than their debut get an estimated history so captaincy, veteran traits and wear are consistent: proSeasons = age - sampled debut age; careerRounds = round(proSeasons * roundsPerSeasonPlayed * U); wear = the decline table summed over the human-years already lived past 31; each pro season rolls scarChancePerSeasonPlayed for a scar; acquired-trait thresholds are then checked once.

hiredBlade._doc: Hook for open-006 (league/economy owns the rule). Generated like a free agent with qualityShiftExamples.hiredBlade, humanAge band 24-33, normal trait roll, on one-match terms; earns XP like anyone else.

soakTargets._doc: Pass bands for the 20-season headless soak test (spec section 8). Measured from season 3 so world-generation warm-up is excluded.
soakTargets._ageBandNote: Widened for D-T (veterans play on): see core/fighters README.

leagues._doc: World and competition structure: regions, tiers, wings (conferences), regular-season schedule, standings, the season-ending tournament, promotion/relegation and the season calendar. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-league-economy.md (sys-league, sys-calendar, sys-tournament). Money values live in economy.json; clubs in clubs.json.

generationShifts._doc: Potential shifts owned by league-economy and read by the lifecycle generator (development.json potential.qualityShiftExamples).
generationShifts.worldGenFreeAgentsPerClub: Resolved by D-C: 2.5 per club (120 at 48 clubs); the number lives in development.json generation.worldGen.freeAgentsPerClub

wings._doc: Each tier splits into two wings of 8 clubs, redrawn every season by serpentine on the seed order (see regularSeason.seedOrder). Wing ids are shared by all tiers.

crossPairing._doc: k = a club's index (0-7) in its wing by seed order. Cross week 1: dawn[k] v dusk[k]. Cross week 2: dawn[k] v dusk[7-k]. In odd seasons dawn hosts cross week 1 and dusk hosts cross week 2; even seasons swap.

seedOrder._doc: Order used for the serpentine wing draw and cross pairing. Season 1: by startPrestige (desc), ties by club id. Later seasons: clubs relegated from the tier above (by their final tier-table rank), then clubs that stayed (by final tier-table rank), then clubs promoted from below (Reckoning champion first, then the Shield route).

standings.restartOnSplit: When a criterion separates part of a tied group, each remaining tied subgroup restarts from headToHeadPoints.

tables.wing: the 8 clubs of one wing; decides qualification and relegation
tables.tier: all 16 clubs; decides tournament seeding, the Shield, table prize money and promotion via the Shield route

tournament._doc: Season-ending knockout of 8 clubs per tier (O9). Single matches, no replays.
tournament.seeding: wing winners are seeds 1-2 (ordered by the tier table); the other six qualifiers are seeds 3-8 (ordered by the tier table)

promotionRelegation._doc: Applied between each adjacent pair of tiers at season end. Tier 1 has no promotion and the lowest tier has no relegation in M1.

promotionRoutes.rule: the lower tier's tier-table #1; if it is also the champion, the next-highest club in that tier table

venues.name: The Charterhall
venues.use: neutral venue for every tournament final

calendar._doc: One season = 23 played weeks plus the season-end step. Every Continue processes exactly one week. The free-agent market is open in every week.
seasonEndOrder: next_season_setup (tiers, wings, fixtures, caps, drop clause, tier minimums, grants, parachutes, budgets, patron goals, trials rookies)

clubs._doc: Clubs of the default theme (fantasy mercenaries). Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-league-economy.md (content model, sys-league, sys-ai-manager). Every club is an original identity. startTierLevel/startPrestige apply to a new career only; afterwards tier and prestige live in the save. aiPersonality ids are defined in economy.json aiPersonalities; tacticsStyle matches the stance tags of the per-class presets (combat). Colors are #RRGGBB; colorRules are checked by the content validator.
clubs.status: PROPOSED · EXAMPLE default-theme content (league-economy designer, 2026-10-25). Names and colors may be reskinned freely (T5); counts per tier must match leagues.json.

colorRules._doc: Validator thresholds. Contrast is the WCAG ratio between a club's primary and secondary. Delta E is CIEDE2000. pair distance = dE(A.primary,B.primary) + dE(A.secondary,B.secondary), so every club's two-color identity differs from every other club's. kit distance = max(dE(A.primary,B.primary), dE(A.primary,B.secondary), dE(A.secondary,B.primary)) and must allow every pairing to be told apart. clashDeltaE is the presentation rule: when home and away primaries are closer than this, the away side shows its secondary as its main color.

economy._doc: Economy tunables: money, wages, contracts, free-agent market, finance rules, prestige, M1-light patron goal, AI club personalities and soak-test targets. Spec: docs/design/_drafts/03-league-economy.md (sys-finance, sys-contracts, sys-transfers, sys-ai-manager, sys-patron). All money is integer gold (display name from 'currency'). Ratios and modifiers are integer basis points (bp, 10000 = 100%). Step tables are [key, value] pairs: use the entry with the largest key <= the lookup value. Each formula rounds once at its end (toward zero) unless it says otherwise (03 §1).
economy.status: PROPOSED · TUNABLE — every number is a starting value for soak-test tuning (league-economy designer, 2026-10-25). Not approved.

currency._doc: Mechanical term is 'gold' (01 §7). The default theme displays it as tessels: arena tokens struck by the Charter Registry. Owner confirmation needed (league-economy draft, Owner confirmations).

season._doc: Wages, ops costs and sponsor retainers are charged/paid at every week processing of the season calendar (leagues.json calendar). Must equal the calendar's week count.

grantInstallments._doc: credited in next-season setup, before P1 opens
credited in the week processing that ends MW8

sponsorRetainer._doc: retainer = sponsorRetainerBase * (10000 + clamp(prestigeBpPerPoint * (prestige - tierBasePrestige), minAdjBp, maxAdjBp)) / 10000. Paid in equal weekly parts (floor(retainer / 23)); the remainder is paid with the last week.

gate._doc: gate = gateBase * (10000 + prestigeAdj + formAdj + fanAppealAdj) * stageBp / 100000000. prestigeAdj = clamp(prestigeBpPerPoint * (prestige - tierBasePrestige)). formAdj = formMinBp + formSpanBp * winsSoFar / matchesSoFar, counting this season's league and tournament matches before this fixture (0 before the first match). fanAppealAdj = fanAppealBpPerPoint * sum of fanAppeal trait points of the home lineup, capped. The tournament final is played at the neutral venue and its gate is split evenly (odd unit to the higher seed).

tablePrize._doc: prize(rank) = floor10(tablePrizeTop * (clubCount + 1 - rank) / clubCount), by final tier-table rank 1..16. Paid at season end.

parachuteBpOfGrantGap._doc: A relegated club receives (old tier centralGrant - new tier centralGrant) * bp / 10000 in each of the next seasons listed, credited at next-season setup. Stops early if the club is promoted again.

startingBalance._doc: New career only: startingBalanceBase * (10000 + clamp(bpPerPrestigePoint * (startPrestige - tierBasePrestige))) / 10000, floor10.

budget._doc: Season budget SB = central grant installments due this season (after any Registry deduction) + parachute + promotion grant + sponsor retainer + projected gate (homeFixturesPerClub * regular-season gate at formAdj 0, fanAppealAdj 0). Wage budget per week WB = floor((SB * (wageRatioBp + ascensionBp) / 10000 + reserveContribution) / wageWeeksPerSeason). reserveContribution = min(SB * reserveCapBp / 10000, max(0, balanceAtSetup - SB * reserveFloorBp / 10000) * reserveSpendRateBp / 10000). Both are fixed for the season at next-season setup.

worldGenBillBandBp._doc: New career (D-P): opening bills are rescaled into this share of WB, leaving room for the trials rookie and a tier-minimum signing.

wage._doc: marketWage = curve(EQ) * (10000 + ageAdj + traitAdj + roleDemandAdj + fanAppealAdj) / 10000, floor to a multiple of 5. EQ = clamp(rating + (min(potential - rating, potentialGapCap) * potentialWeightBp(humanAge)) / 10000, 1, 100), toward zero. humanAge = floor(age * 80 / race.lifespan) (lifecycle). curve: integer linear interpolation between anchors [rating, weekly gold], toward zero. Anchors follow 200 * 2^((r - 50) / 12).

traitAdj._doc: Each trait adds positiveBp or negativeBp by polarity unless overridden by id. Economy-hook traits (traits.json effect type 'economy'): fanAppeal adds fanAppealBpPerPoint per point to the market wage and to home gate; wageDemandMult adds (mult - 1) * 10000 bp to the ask; loyalty subtracts loyaltyBpPerPoint per point from renewal asks with the current club.

roleDemandBp._doc: Static class-demand premium per combat role (P-09 'class demand'). A hybrid uses the larger of its two roles. All 0 until soak tests show a scarce role.

ask._doc: ask(f, club, L) = marketWage * (10000 + clamp(tierGapAdj + prestigeAdj + lengthAdj + greedBp + wageDemandAdj + situationAdj, totalMinBp, totalMaxBp)) / 10000, floor to a multiple of 5, then clamp to [club tierMinWage, maxWeeklyWage]. calibre(f) = the first tier whose minRating <= rating, else the lowest tier.

length._doc: preferredLength: 1 if humanAge <= youngMaxHumanAge and potential - rating >= youngMinPotentialGap; 3 if humanAge >= veteranMinHumanAge; otherwise 2. lengthAdj = mismatchBpPerSeason * |L - preferredLength|.

greed._doc: Contract temperament, rolled once at fighter generation from the 'market' stream: uniform over [minBp, maxBp] in steps of stepBp. Visible in M1 as its label (and exact in M1 debug views).

renewalSituation._doc: Renewals only. startedShareBp = matches this fighter started for the club this season * 10000 / club matches played this season (0 matches played -> no adjustment).

negotiation._doc: ratio = offer * 10000 / ask (or / the club's valid counter price). ratio >= 10000: acceptable. 10000 - flexBp <= ratio < 10000: the fighter counters at floor5((offer + ask) / 2). Lower: refused. Renewals answer at once; free-agent offers are answered at week processing.

capRelief._doc: After relegation, a club over its new cap may release up to (roster - cap) fighters during P1-P4 with no payout. AI clubs and the player use the same allowance.

hiredBlade._doc: Short-handed rule (open-006): paid the tier minimum wage for the one week of the match; not on the roster.

market._doc: Free-agent market rules (sys-transfers). Every free-agent offer is answered at week processing; trials-day rookies and renewals are exclusive and answer at once.
market.decisionOrder: marketWage desc, then fighter id asc

trialsDay._doc: Rookie count per season comes from development.json generation.intake. Each club receives floor(rookies / clubs); the remainder goes one each to clubs drawn by lot (stream rookies). Exclusive to that club during P1; unsigned rookies enter the free-agent pool at P1 week processing, before the AI action phase.
trialsDay._maxAskNote: Rookie scale (D-P): on Trials Day a rookie asks his club at most this share of the tier minimum.

embargo._doc: Entered when balance < 0 after week processing; lifted at the first week processing that ends with balance >= 0. While embargoed: no free-agent offer or renewal above the tier minimum wage; a free-agent offer is allowed only at the tier minimum, length 1, no signing cost, and only while the club has fewer than 5 fit roster fighters; trials rookies are blocked.

registryAdvance._doc: After this many consecutive week processings with balance < 0, the Charter Registry pays the debt (balance := 0). The advance is deducted from future central grants, at most deductionCapBpOfGrant of each season's grant, interest-free, until repaid.

prestige._doc: Club prestige 0-100. Tier base values are leagues.json tiers[].basePrestige. Season-end update: delta = tableTerm + tournamentTerm + movementTerm - advancePenalty; tableTerm = (clubCount + 1 - 2 * rank) * tableNumerator / tableDenominator (toward zero); new = clamp(old + delta - (old + delta - newTierBase) * reversionBp / 10000, 0, 100).

patron._doc: M1-light patron goal: REJECTED for M1 by D-C (no patron goal or patron bonus in M1; patron arrives in M6). Kept disabled as a hook. One goal per club per season, shown at P1; meeting it pays tierProfiles.patronBonus at season end; missing it costs nothing. The M6 patron (patience, dismissal) is separate.

goals.default: finish the tier table at or above (prestige rank within the tier + expectedRankSlack), capped at clubCount
goals.relegatedLastSeason: finish in the top 4 of its wing
